Gold: Total: 2700g (Sell: 1890g)
Stats: Attack Damage: 55
Tags: Damage, Active, NonbootsMovement, ArmorPenetration

[Passive] Preparation: After being out of combat with Champions for 8 seconds gain Lethality. This Lethality lasts for 3 seconds after dealing damage to champions.

[Passive] Extraction: When a champion that you damaged within 3 seconds dies, gain 200 decaying Move Speed for 1.5 seconds.
